review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineering
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines. Establish and maintain data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes. Partner with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Participate in on-call support, production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of data services. Qualifica
eligibility_evidence: Perks of working @ Axis Flexible hybrid working model Medical insurance for you and your family Life insurance coverage Subsidized gym membership Competitive leave policy
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Partner with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Qualifications Several years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar role. Proficiency with Git, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment practices. Familiarity with data governance, privacy, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements for financial services.
